component.name: MultiSelect
component.description: Dropdown select component with search, multi-select, and custom item rendering.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Select root that owns open state, value display, and popup positioning.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Popup panel that contains search input, options, groups, and empty state.

slots.name: listbox
slots.description: ARIA listbox that contains selectable options.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Selectable option row inside the listbox.

slots.name: group
slots.description: Option group wrapper inside the listbox.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Group label or option label text, depending on context.

slots.name: control
slots.description: Multi-select control that displays selected tags and opens the popup.

slots.name: input
slots.description: Search input used to filter or add selections.

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Icon shown before the selected tags and search input.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Button region that toggles the multi-select popup.

slots.name: clear
slots.description: Button used to clear all selected values.

slots.name: tagsContainer
slots.description: Wrapper that lays out selected value tags inside the control.

slots.name: tagRemove
slots.description: Button used to remove one selected value.

slots.name: tagOverflow
slots.description: Counter shown when selected tags exceed the visible limit.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Message shown when filtering leaves no selectable options.

slots.name: itemLabel
slots.description: Primary label text inside an option row.

slots.name: itemDescription
slots.description: Supporting description text inside an option row.

slots.name: itemTrailing
slots.description: Trailing region inside an option row, usually for selection state or custom content.

own.name: allowClear
own.description: Show a clear button when a value is selected.

own.name: allowCreate
own.description: Allow creating new tags on Enter when no match is found.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: closeIcon
own.description:
Icon used when the action button clears the selection.
Tag remove buttons keep using this icon as well.

own.name: defaultOpen
own.description: Initial open state.

own.name: defaultSearchValue
own.description: Default search value.

own.name: defaultValue
own.description: The default value of the input (uncontrolled).

own.name: disabled
own.description: Whether the input is disabled.

own.name: emptyRender
own.description: Custom renderer for the empty state when current filtered result has no matches.

own.name: filterOption
own.type: boolean | "startsWith" | "endsWith" | "contains" | ((inputValue: string, option: MultiSelectT.Item<TItem>) => boolean) | undefined
own.description: Filter function or boolean. `false` disables filtering.

own.name: gutter
own.description: Gap (px) between the control and popup content.

own.name: id
own.description: The ID of the input element.

own.name: labelRender
own.description: Custom renderer for the option label text.

own.name: leadingIcon
own.description: Icon shown before the input/value area.

own.name: loading
own.description: Whether the select is in a loading state.

own.name: loadingIcon
own.description: Icon shown during loading state.

own.name: maxCount
own.description: Maximum number of selected values (multiple/tags).

own.name: maxTagCount
own.description: Maximum visible tags before showing +N (visual only).

own.name: name
own.description: The name of the input element, used for form submission.

own.name: onChange
own.description: Called when the selection changes.

own.name: onClear
own.description: Called when clear is triggered.

own.name: onOpenChange
own.description: Called whenever the popup open state changes.

own.name: onScrollBottom
own.description: Called when the listbox is scrolled to bottom. Useful for infinite loading scenarios. Make sure to set `overflowPadding` and `scrollBottomThreshold` appropriately to ensure the callback is triggered at the right time.

own.name: onSearch
own.description: Called when the search input changes.

own.name: open
own.description: Controlled open state.

own.name: optionRender
own.description: Custom renderer for each option in the dropdown. Passes `null` for empty state.

own.name: options
own.description: Available options.

own.name: overflowPadding
own.description: Padding (px) used when calculating popup overflow and viewport collision.

own.name: placeholder
own.description: Placeholder text shown when no value is selected.

own.name: required
own.description: Whether the input is required.

own.name: scrollBottomThreshold
own.description: Distance (px) from the bottom at which onScrollBottom fires.

own.name: searchMaxLength
own.description: Maximum search text length applied on final commit.

own.name: searchValue
own.description: Controlled search value.

own.name: tagRender
own.description: Custom renderer for each selected tag (multiple/tags).

own.name: tagVariant
own.description: Variant for the selected tags.

own.name: tokenSeparators
own.description: Characters that split input into tokens and immediately select them.

own.name: trailingIcon
own.description: Icon used when the action button opens the dropdown.

own.name: value
own.description: The current value of the input (controlled).

own.name: virtualized
own.description: Enables virtualized-like aria metadata on options.

props.name: children
props.description: One-layer child options for grouped select.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown next to the label.

props.name: key
props.description: Text key used for filtering and matching; set this when `label` is not a string.

props.name: label
props.description: Label to display for the option, or the option group title.
